answer: Require every agent to attach a fresh hardware attestation quote from a trusted execution environment to each epoch claim. One quote binds one identity to one physical machine, so a thousand sybils means a thousand machines: attack cost scales with hardware, not code. A public summit registry lists attested devices and rejects duplicate quotes as replays. As a live signal, each device also emits a periodic heartbeat, and a missed pulse freezes its rewards until it re-attests. Honest agents on real hardware pass cheaply; fake fleets pay full price each.
